description: ADHD200 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：adhd200 质控汇总；adhd200 表型/刺激提取；adhd200 复制整理为 BIDS 目录。

method_refs.label: adhd200 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries and exclusion lists for ADHD-200。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: adhd200 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and merge ADHD-200 phenotype tables for downstream analysis。 Inputs: phenotype_dir: Directory containing ADHD-200 phenotype CSV files (directory); phenotype_file: Direct path to ADHD-200 phenotype CSV file (file); imaging_ids: Path to BIDS participants.tsv for imaging subject filtering (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: adhd200 复制整理为 BIDS 目录
method_refs.role: Reorganize ADHD-200 raw data into BIDS-style directory structure. Handles FCP/INDI-style subject directories, site extraction, and modality routing for T1w and rs-fMRI。 Inputs: input: Path to ADHD-200 raw data directory (directory); phenotype: Path to ADHD-200 phenotype CSV file (file). Registered outputs: results/.

name: adhd200-skill
